title: VideoKR: Towards Knowledge- and Reasoning-Intensive Video Understanding

layout.note: Four grey-titled bands stacked top to bottom: a full-width domain band (donut in the middle, two chip lists on each side), a band split into a skills triangle and a film strip, and a band of three stacked tinted QA cards.

lesson: Build a dataset overview from titled bands: a domain donut with colour-matched topic chips, a skill key drawn as icons, one raw sample, and tinted example cards tagged with the same skill icons, so every example visibly links back to the key.
